title: Fixed Twin Handle and Low Tap Beverage Urn
description: One original complete static countertop beverage-urn appearance. A low wide pedestal carries a tall slightly stepped closed tank exterior with a fitted shallow lid and top knob. Two opposed open side handles are part of the whole assembly. A low forward tap curves downward and has a genuine visible open nozzle wall, a short upper stem and a fixed paddle control. A separate shallow raised-rim drip tray is integrated in front of the base, with real spaced grate bars. Three opaque untextured PBR roles. New complete equipment, not an industrial firebox boiler or hand gooseneck kettle rescaled. One prop and zero scenes. The tank is a closed exterior representation; no internal tank or connected fluid circuit is claimed. No water, beverage, heat, cord, pressure, electrical function, use instructions, capacity, sanitation or safety claim. Static display only.
